title: Cyber Wooden Fish
tagline: A playful crypto platform where tokens are pumped using your phone's accelerometer and ZKTLS. Accumulate merit points to issue tokens. Designed for real-world social FOMO, turning memes into a movement. It’s crypto fun with a spiritual twist!
description:
Introducing an innovative crypto platform that redefines token creation and trading. Inspired by the concept of an electronic "wooden fish," users can issue tokens only after earning merit points through platform activities. Retail users, however, can pump tokens only by engaging physically—using their smartphone's accelerometer combined with ZKTLS (zero-knowledge trust layer).

Our platform thrives in social environments, where the fun of FOMO transforms token memes into community-driven phenomena, making it easier for memes to transcend into cultural or even spiritual movements. With a mix of playful interactions and crypto mechanics, we’re building a bridge between digital assets and real-world engagement.
how_its_made: The platform is built using TypeScript with a ZKTLS (zero-knowledge trust layer) vLayer, and integrates Dynamic AA (account abstraction) wallets to enable , secure interactions. It leverages smartphone accelerometer data and cutting-edge cryptography for an innovative and engaging user experience.
